Headline: Westbound #126 Jackson & Eastbound #124 Navy Pier buses Temporary Reroute near Van Buren/Clinton
ShortDescription: Westbound #126 Jackson & Eastbound #124 Navy Pier buses temporarily rerouted, due to construction near Van Buren/Clinton.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Westbound #126 Jackson & Eastbound #124 Navy Pier buses temporarily rerouted, due to construction near Van Buren/Clinton.

Eastbound #124 Navy Pier buses will operate via Clinton, Harrison, Jefferson and over regular route.

Westbound #126 Jackson buses will operate via Adams, Des Plaines, Van Buren and over regular route.

Allow extra travel time.
